verdict.rationale: Flutterwave's API docs link a first-party Postman collection for the v3 API that users can import and run. That is a machine-readable, downloadable description of the API, but it is not a formal schema spec. Probes of standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404, and llms.txt is a documentation index rather than an API spec. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/Swagger (or equivalent schema-level) spec, a documented download location, and request/response schema definitions suitable for codegen or agent tool generation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The [Postman collection](https://www.postman.com/lively-zodiac-773579/flutterwave-api/collection/9qa6trt/flutterwave-v3) lets you call the API without writing code.
Import it, add your API keys, and edit the sample data.
